en: Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a narrow, curving street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings, shops and hotels. A church tower with an onion dome rises in the background. Text in German advertises a hotel with central heating, electric light, an elevator and baths. At the bottom in red print it identifies the scene as Karlsbad and the hotel "W. Gärtner's Hôtel Nürnberger Hof" on Kirchengasse, opposite the Sprudel (hot spring). Handwritten red numbers appear along the right edge.
